slides.headline: Europe just built a cybersecurity AI anyone can own
What is Le Chonk
slides.body: Mistral's new 1-trillion-parameter AI model, trained in Europe on 3,800 advanced chips, now in public preview

slides.headline: Why open weights matter
slides.body: You download and run it yourself — no company can revoke access or block legitimate security research

slides.headline: Beats closed models on security
slides.body: Ranks top 5 globally for finding and fixing real software flaws, leading all non-Chinese open models

slides.headline: The catch: still early
slides.body: Preview only; full weights release end of month. Red-teaming with governments ongoing — not yet for casual use
